expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Declares the generic set type. Each TSet<T> instantiation validates element hashing and equality operations. Declares the mutable set iterator type. Declares the read-only set iterator type. Constructs an empty set; element lifetimes are managed automatically. Copy-constructs a mutable iterator. Reports whether the mutable iterator refers to a valid element. Copy-constructs a read-only iterator. Reports whether the read-only iterator refers to a valid element. Iterates elements through the mutable or const opFor protocol.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result. Verify size, element values, ordering, and empty result behavior that apply to the listed overloads.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: template<class T> struct TSet; | template<class T> struct TSetIterator; | template<class T> struct TSetConstIterator; | TSet<T> Set; | TSetIterator<T> It(const TSetIterator<T>& Other); | bool TSetIterator<T>.CanProceed; | TSetConstIterator<T> It(const TSetConstIterator<T>& Other); | bool TSetConstIterator<T>.CanProceed; | for (auto Value : Set) { Use(Value); }
